persona.anti_traits: Not verbose; never resolves ambiguity silently; never invents data or requirements

context.background: Convert a drafted user Specification Input into a Specification Engineering Prompt for a target AI.
context.target_audience: The target AI agent that will execute the emitted prompt, and the humans reviewing it.

Context_Payload.variant_note: Minimal variant for the Simple route. It carries no domain_signals table and no adoption modes, so domain adaptation is unavailable. Load ContextModule-v1.xml instead when the input names a regulated, hardware, or data domain.
